purpose: ProToolHub Cartoon mascot: four candidates, the operator chooses one
base_prompt: Mascot illustration for a friendly photo-to-cartoon website. A cute, playful chibi girl with a big head and a small body, holding a big wooden pencil that is almost as tall as she is. Full body, centred, facing the viewer, with clear empty space around her. Clean cartoon style: smooth bold outlines, flat colours with soft cel shading. Wholesome and fully clothed, suitable for all ages. No text, no letters, no logo, no watermark, no scenery, plain transparent background.

candidates.prompt: Pose: standing and hugging the pencil upright with both arms, head tilted. Colours: teal top and pink skirt, close to #6cc9d1 and #f48fb1, dark brown hair in two short pigtails. Expression: a wink and a wide open smile.

Pose: sitting astride the pencil as if it were flying, one hand raised in the air. Colours: mustard-yellow overalls over a white shirt, orange hair clips, black bob haircut. Expression: laughing with her eyes closed.

Pose: resting the pencil on her shoulder and waving with the other hand. Colours: lavender hoodie, mint-green shorts, white sneakers, long auburn ponytail. Expression: a big cheerful grin with sparkling eyes.

candidates.pose: draws a swirl in the air
candidates.prompt: Pose: leaning forward and drawing a big curly line in the air with the pencil tip, which leaves a small trail of sparkles. Colours: red beret, navy dress with a white collar, red sneakers, short black hair. Expression: concentrating, tongue poking out playfully.
